name: Behringer X-Touch Compact
notes: Standard MIDI mode (not MC), factory preset addressing. The hardware has an A/B layer switch: the same physical control sends different MIDI addresses per layer. Layer B counterparts carry a -b id suffix and share the layer-A position. The 16 rotary encoders send ABSOLUTE CC values in the default hardware config, so they are modeled as circular faders (the v2 encoder type is for relative encoding). The right-side encoders 9-16 additionally exist as knob-N-rel encoder controls for units whose knobs are re-configured to relative mode via the X-Touch editor - knob-N-abs and knob-N-rel describe the same physical knob. Feedback in standard mode: v1 sent MA3 fader values back as a CC message on the control's own CC number (never pitchbend) - the motorized faders follow it and the encoder LED rings display it. That is why every absolute-CC control here is marked motorized. Only layer-A encoder rotation is addressed; the layer-B rotation CCs were unused in v1 and are omitted.
